ideal: Context is finite: keep each call small and cached, spend tokens on work that merges, and give subagents focused tasks that return condensed summaries.

sources.title: Effective context engineering for AI agents

quality: Few tokens go to pull requests that close unmerged.
speed: Most input is read from the cache, and sessions rarely fill their context and compact.
consumption: Few new tokens per merged pull request, small contexts, cheap subagents with short returns, and the plan never runs out.
